context.caption: Multivariable Analysis of Factors Associated With Progression of Calcification
context.caption_markup: <caption><title>Multivariable Analysis of Factors Associated With Progression of Calcification</title></caption>
context.foot_markup:
Abbreviations: AAC, abdominal aortic calcification; BMI, body mass index (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared); CAC, coronary artery calcification; CPB, calcium-based phosphate binder; CVC, cardiac valve calcification; FGF-23, fibroblast growth factor 23; hs-CRP, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein; iPTH, intact parathyroid hormone; MAP, mean arterial pressure; OR, odds ratio.

SI conversion factors: To convert serum calcium from milligrams per deciliter to millimoles per liter, multiply by 0.25; to convert serum phosphorus from milligrams per deciliter to millimoles per liter, multiply by 0.323.

For CAC progression, baseline calcification was adjusted as baseline log multiplied by the sum of CAC plus 1. For AAC progression, baseline calcification was adjusted as baseline log multiplied by the sum of AAC plus 1 for AAC progression. For CVC progression, baseline calcification was adjusted by the number of CVCs.
context.label: Table 2.
notes: Abbreviations: AAC, abdominal aortic calcification; BMI, body mass index (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared); CAC, coronary artery calcification; CPB, calcium-based phosphate binder; CVC, cardiac valve calcification; FGF-23, fibroblast growth factor 23; hs-CRP, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein; iPTH, intact parathyroid hormone; MAP, mean arterial pressure; OR, odds ratio.

For CVC progression, baseline calcification was adjusted by the number of CVCs.
